title: Support pollination and fruit set
summary: Protect flowering access, identify pollination needs and avoid treating every failed flower as a fertilizer problem.
steps: Identify whether the crop is self-pollinating, wind-pollinated, insect-pollinated or requires another compatible variety.
Provide continuous suitable flowering habitat and clean shallow water nearby without creating mosquito breeding.
Avoid unnecessary broad-spectrum pesticide use, especially while crops or nearby plants are flowering.
For protected or indoor crops, use the crop-appropriate hand-pollination or vibration method only when needed.
Record temperature, wind, pollinator activity and fruit set before changing irrigation or fertilizer.
warnings: Do not introduce purchased insects or move wild pollinator nests without expert and legal guidance.
Pesticide labels and local pollinator-protection rules take priority over this summary.
common_mistakes: Scaling up before a small controlled trial.
